author: rangeluisalonso
quote: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time – 10/10Honestly, I love this game. Ocarina of Time has always been one of those games that makes me feel like a kid again. The remake brings back so many memories while making everything look and feel even better.Exploring Hyrule, listening to the soundtrack, solving puzzles, and fighting bosses never gets old. I especially love how the story makes you feel connected to the characters and the ****’s one of those games that stays with you long after you finish it. I could play it over and over again and never get tired of it. Definitely one of my all-time favorites.10/10. A true masterpiece that deserves all the love it gets.
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time

author: rangeluisalonso
quote: Honestly, I expected a lot more from GTA 6. The game has way too many bugs and glitches that ruin the experience. The whole robbery system feels poorly designed, and some of the mechanics are frustrating and unnecessarily complicated. For a game with this much hype, it feels unfinished and poorly optimized.There are some good things about it, but the bugs, clunky gameplay, and disappointing robbery mechanics make it hard to enjoy. Rockstar needs to fix a lot of things before this game deserves the praise it gets. Thanks for reading
